data.change_summary: Added backward-compat handling for the renamed plant half-saturation parameters in both save loading and process preset loading. Legacy save payloads now migrate `plant_half_saturation_{n,p,c}_mg_total` into the explicit water-column fields and derive the new substrate N/P fields from the same legacy values, and process preset loading now rewrites the legacy plant TOML keys before deserialization so non-default values are preserved instead of falling back to defaults. I also added targeted regressions for the legacy save and preset cases, plus small stale call-site alignments in scenario/cycling code that were needed to get the targeted validation path compiling on the current branch.
outstanding_risks: Broader `tank_core` save-load regression coverage is still blocked by an unrelated compile break in `crates/tank_core/src/types/habitat.rs` where `HabitatEnv.depth_attenuation` is referenced but not present, so I only validated the targeted compatibility regressions.
The worktree contains concurrent non-fix edits in the same save/preset area; this update was validated against the exact plant-compat regression paths, not the full workspace test suite.

steps.description: Inspected the current save migration chain and process preset loading path to confirm the legacy plant half-saturation keys were silently falling back to defaults.
Added save compatibility logic so legacy plant half-saturation total fields are converted into the explicit concentration/areal fields during load.
Added a process preset compatibility parser and routed `load_process_params_with_diagnostics` through it so legacy plant TOML keys are rewritten before deserialization.
Added targeted regression coverage for a legacy save payload and a legacy process preset TOML, and aligned stale renamed-parameter call sites that were blocking those targeted test paths.

Attempted broader save-load regression validation beyond the exact compatibility tests, but that path is currently blocked by the unrelated `HabitatEnv.depth_attenuation` compile error in the worktree.

validation_evidence: Attempted `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load save_load_roundtrip -- --exact`, but it is currently blocked by an unrelated compile failure in `crates/tank_core/src/types/habitat.rs` referencing missing field `HabitatEnv.depth_attenuation`.
